name: Joint Doctoral Program in Cell and Molecular Biology
institution: San Diego State University / University of California, San Diego

deadlines.label: SDSU supplement and official materials; UCSD application

documents: Statement of purpose (usually one to three pages)

applicationFee.note: SDSU Cal State Apply is nonrefundable and cannot be waived. Joint applicants receive a UCSD application fee waiver and are exempt from UCSD’s international credential-evaluation requirement.

english.toefl: UCSD: 85 previous scale / 4.5 new scale; SDSU program: 80 before January 21, 2026 / 4 thereafter
english.note: Meet both campus policies. UCSD accepts IELTS Academic; degree exemptions require B/3.0 or better and foreign institutions listed in WHED as solely English, with no substitute letters. SDSU allows qualifying English-principal-instruction degrees verified on official transcripts. Scores have two-year validity; SDSU measures from filing-period start.

requirements.note: Biology/related bachelor’s; GPA 3.0 in last 60 units and upper-division biology. Both campus applications mandatory, with matching name/email. SDSU requires official records/scores and Slate supplement; UCSD initially accepts unofficial records/self-reported English results. Three letters required, up to five allowed in SDSU supplement. Cannot also apply to standalone UCSD Biological Sciences. No faculty sponsor needed before application.

funding.note: SDSU states doctoral students receive tuition and financial support. Amount, duration and international coverage are not explicitly specified.

international.note: Foreign degree records and certified literal English translations required where applicable. Research is based at SDSU with one year of UCSD coursework.
